title: Physical AC1024 fit-only SPLINE fields compared with LibreDWG

formatAuthority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
formatAuthority.relevantRule: The common scenario is a BL. R2013+ adds BL Spline flags 1 and BL Knot parameter fields before the common degree. Fit-point scenario records then contain fit tolerance, beginning/end tangent vectors, a BL fit-point count, and fit points.

input.fixtureDisposition: Existing local user corpus; not copied into or committed with the repository.

libdxfrw.strictOutputDisposition: Preflight refused publication because the complete DWG read disposition is not qualified. No DXF output was published; this is not a successful whole-file conversion.

comparison.method: Matched SPLINE records by decoded DWG handle. Compared scenario, degree, fit-point count, and ordered fit-point coordinates. The libdxfrw trace prints coordinates to six decimal places; tolerance is 5.1e-7 model units.

newerVersionSourceInventory.scanner: LibreDWG 0.14 JSON output searched for SPLINE entity tokens
newerVersionSourceInventory.limitation: This is an inventory of tracked repository drawings only. It does not establish that no external or local-untracked newer-version spline source exists.

limits: This is a two-record physical field differential, not curve evaluation, B-rep validation, or native CAD acceptance.
The R2013+ splFlag1/Knot parameter body has no SPLINE witness among the six tracked AC1027/AC1032 drawings inspected; its physical DWG profile remains open.
The DXF output was refused at whole-document strict-completeness preflight. No output or support claim is qualified by this run.
No fixtures, production code, tests, or external dependencies were added.
